decoder: Actual vendored Three GLTFLoader + MeshoptDecoder; CPU only
normal_policy_source: Existing tools/qa/compare_model_compression.mjs used for prior accepted building packages; per-corner normals need not be byte identical.
normal_processing_source: gltfpack 1.3.0 -cc -noq -km -ke; actual raw and decoded web NORMAL accessors are FLOAT32. Measured exporter normal rounding/optimization is reported separately from exact positions; no integer-normal quantization bit depth is asserted.
aperture_scope: Each actual raw/web/LOD: 28 through doors x9 interior rays, 28 blind panels x3 backing rays, 56 solid wall negative controls across all seven levels/eight source edges. Rays target the wall shell only, not legitimate separate rails/columns. Phase is explicitly estimated; this is not compass verification or complete LOD Hausdorff equivalence.
limitations: No browser, native rendering, optics/material match or full geometric Hausdorff comparison of simplified LOD.
The 0-image state is intentional: original photos remain unmodified geometry references.
